modules.description: Single flat PRESENT-80 block cipher core with serial load/unload interface, iterative one-round-per-clock datapath, FSM control, S-box, pLayer, and key schedule all inlined.
modules.name: present80

ports.description: Serial load enable; shift din MSB-first each rising edge
ports.name: load_en

ports.description: Serial data in: 80-bit key then 64-bit plaintext, MSB first
ports.name: din

ports.description: Serial unload enable; shift ciphertext out when done is high
ports.name: shift_out_en

ports.description: Serial ciphertext out, MSB first (ciphertext[63] first)
ports.name: dout

ports.description: Asserted when ciphertext is valid; held until reset or new load
ports.name: done

rationale: The spec explicitly mandates a single flat Verilog module with no sub-modules. All functional blocks (4-state FSM: IDLE/LOAD/ENCRYPT/UNLOAD; 8-bit load counter; 5-bit round counter; 7-bit unload counter; 64-bit state register; 80-bit key register; 16-entry S-box as a combinational case statement; pLayer as a combinational bit-permutation; key schedule rotate+S-box+XOR) are inlined as always blocks and combinational logic inside the single present80 module.
